note: Adapted from the original English description of Krishna & Emerson 1962 (new species; from the Congo); 8 alates and 7 soldiers, the original does not describe the worker. The measurements are translated verbatim from tables 15 and 16 of the original, in millimetres.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Compared with G. parki the alate has a wider head, ocelli that are more oval and angled to the compound eyes, more protruding and differently shaped compound eyes, a wider pronotum with more convex lateral margins, and longer tibiae; G. jurioni, G. sinomalatus and G. ueleensis are smaller in all measurements; compared with G. insulanus the forewing is longer and wider, the compound eyes differently shaped, the ocelli larger, the anterolateral corners of the pronotum narrower, and the antennae 12-segmented; compared with G. kawandae the head is narrower, the compound eyes differently shaped, the ocelli not touching the compound eyes, the lateral margins of the pronotum straighter, and the wings slightly shorter. Before 1962 this species was recorded by Kirby as Glyptotermes sp. nov. (1942a: 116; 1942b: 183; 1945: 257).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown, paler on the postclypeus and below the antennal sockets; antennae brown, the tip of each segment whitish; femora brown; tergites brown; sternites whitish or pale yellow; wing membrane smoky, the wing scales darker than the membrane. Head and body with a small number of scattered erect setae; pronotal margin and surface with long and short setae. Posterior part of the head broad and evenly rounded. Y suture visible. Compound eyes large and protruding; ocelli nearly oval, pointed at the tip, touching the compound eyes. Antennae 13—14-segmented, the second segment longer than or equal to the third, the fourth shorter than the third. Anterior margin of the pronotum broadly concave; lateral margins rounded; posterior margin slightly concave. Media of the hind wing arising from the radial sector beyond the wing scale, about 0.90 mm from the suture. Measurements (mm; 8 alates, values in parentheses are the mean): head length (to the tip of the labrum) 1.20—1.28 (1.26); head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 0.94—0.98 (0.96); head width 1.05—1.09 (1.07); compound eye diameter 0.29—0.32 (0.31); distance below the compound eye 0.13—0.15 (0.14); ocellus length 0.07—0.08 (0.08); pronotum median length 0.56—0.58 (0.57), width 0.94—1.01 (0.98); hind tibia length 0.90; forewing length (from the suture) 6.53—6.90 (6.68), width 1.73—1.80 (1.74).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brown, darker anteriorly; mandibles reddish brown, paler at the base; pronotum ochraceous; antennae and legs pale yellow; tergites and sternites whitish. Head with a small number of scattered erect and short setae; pronotal margin and disc with a few long setae and many short setae. Head long and narrow, the sides almost parallel; middle of the frons concave, the concavity broad and weak; anterodorsal swelling very weak; frontal slope slightly concave; about 40° in lateral view. Y suture faintly visible. Compound eyes small. Labrum linguiform. Outer base of the mandibles rough; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the base of the first narrow, the bases of the second and third broad; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the tip of the first marginal tooth 0.34 mm from the apical tooth. Measurements (mm; 7 soldiers, ranges): head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.69—1.88; head width 1.07—1.13; head height 0.98—1.01; left mandible length 0.86—0.90; maximum postmentum width 0.45—0.49, minimum width 0.23, length 1.13—1.28; pronotum median length 0.53—0.58, maximum length 0.64—0.68, width 0.98—1.05; hind tibia length 0.78—0.82.
